text:
The patient's agitation, aggression, and medication craving suggest a hyperdopaminergic state, most consistent with stimulant intoxication/withdrawal or a psychotic episode involving excess mesolimbic dopamine signaling. This is a clinical inference only—dopamine status cannot be confirmed from behavior alone, and other causes (delirium, serotonin syndrome, anticholinergic toxicity) must be ruled out.
CONFIDENCE: 55
